validation.scope: Unchanged indexes per pack. Expansion changes retrieval; file fusion uses only retained lists. Non-exhaustive file judgments, no model or agent runs.

validation_gate.reason: No additional top-five hits on fresh validation; both arms reach the label ceiling.
validation_gate.decision: Keep ranking defaults; no new opt-in product policy.

importance_probe.scope: Forced query/cache-save overlap on 128 generated Go files. Two alternating observations per arm; counters instrument both arms. Component evidence, not Cockroach wall time.

ranking_results.scope: Development evidence anchors, not exhaustive recall or agent benefit

ranking_gate_observations.note: Gate passed against its historical baseline; this is not exact output parity or attribution to one local repair.

limitations: Labels are non-exhaustive source anchors; all repositories have prior exposure.
Validation ceiling prevents a positive improvement claim; questions were not replaced.
Generated overlap timings do not establish Cockroach timing headroom.
cProfile pre/post timings include different cold encoder initialization and cannot estimate whole-operation speedup.
Local uncommitted changes are not part of published 0.1.6 or verified in the running host MCP.
